items.leave-apply: Employees apply, managers approve, balances update and payroll picks it up — the leave types and holidays set up here are what it reads.
items.leave-types: Leave categories with their annual entitlement; paid leave counts as present in payroll.
items.holidays: Non-working days for payroll: paid, and removed from the LOP working days.
items.commissions: Every commission claim with its collection evidence: what the customer paid, what is claimed (gross − TDS = net), and the status that decides whether payroll pays it.
items.incentive-schemes: How a scheme pays (percent / fixed / slab / open), its target gate, TDS rate, who it applies to and its window — the Calculator computes from this row.
items.commission-calc: Pick a scheme and a month, type the figures, preview with the working, create the entries; the scheme decides the money, never the form.
items.expenses: Field expenses claimed with amount and note; pending until Claim Approvals decides.
items.advance: Part of salary early; on approval the payslip recovers it per month as its own line, read from the closed runs.
items.claims: Expense claims and advances waiting for a decision — approve or reject with a reason; who and when land on the row, why in the trail.
items.loans: Requested → sanctioned → Manager / Director / HR Admin decisions → tenure → EMI derived → EMI start → disbursed; payroll recovers one EMI per closed run as line LOAN-<id>. Same flow as Salary Advance.
items.loan-schedule: The planned EMIs month by month against what the closed runs actually recovered; outstanding = opening − recovered.
items.clawbacks: A commission paid on a case that bounced, recovered on the payslip of its month once approved.
items.bonus-enc: Statutory or festival bonus and leave encashment, approved and paid through payroll.
items.increments: Old CTC to new CTC with the percentage, optional promotion and effective date, routed for approval.
items.exits: Exit and Full-and-Final: clearance, last working day and the settlement.
items.bank-pack: One CSV per approved payroll run — employee, account, IFSC, net — reconciled to the run or not produced.
